arxiv-2208-13095.title: Geodesic Growth of Numbered Graph Products
arxiv-2208-13095.creator: Kathleen Zopff
arxiv-2208-13095.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kathleen Zopff. In this paper, we study geodesic growth of numbered graph products; these are a generalization of right-angled Coxeter groups, defined as graph products of finite cyclic groups. We first define a graph-theoretic condition called link-regularity, as well as a natural equivalence amongst link-regular numbered graphs, and show that numbered graph products associated to equivalent link-regular numbered graphs must have the same geodesic growth series. Next, we derive a formula for the geodesic growth of right-angled Coxeter groups associated to equivalent link-regular graphs.

arxiv-2311-02542.title: VR-NeRF: High-Fidelity Virtualized Walkable Spaces Conference: SIGGRAPH Asia 2023 Conference Papers; December 12–15, 2023; Sydney, NSW, Australia SIGGRAPH Asia 2023 Conference Papers (SA Conference Papers ’23), December 12–15, 2023, Sydney, NSW, Australia DOI: 10.1145/3610548.3618139 ISBN: 979-8-400
arxiv-2311-02542.creator: Linning Xu, Vasu Agrawal, William Laney, Tony Garcia, Aayush Bansal, Changil Kim, Samuel Rota Bulò, Lorenzo Porzi, Peter Kontschieder, Aljaž Božič, Dahua Lin, Michael Zollhöfer, Christian Richardt
arxiv-2311-02542.description: Abstract . We present an end-to-end system for the high-fidelity capture, model reconstruction, and real-time rendering of walkable spaces in virtual reality using neural radiance fields. To this end, we designed and built a custom multi-camera rig to densely capture walkable spaces in high fidelity and with multi-view high dynamic range images in unprecedented quality and density.

arxiv-2406-14810.title: A granular scaling approach to landslide runout
arxiv-2406-14810.creator: Rory T. Cerbus, Ludovic Brivady, Thierry Faug, Hamid Kellay
arxiv-2406-14810.description: Abstract A main objective in landslide research is to predict how far they will travel. Landslides are complex, and a complete understanding in principle requires accounting for numerous parameters. Here we engender a simplification by investigating the maximum landslide runout using granular laboratory experiments and a scaling analysis.

arxiv-2408-09502.title: The Electrical Design of a Membrane Antenna for Lunar-based Low-frequency Radio Telescope
arxiv-2408-09502.creator: Suonanben, Fengquan Wu \correspondingAuthor, Kai He, Shijie Sun, Wei Zhou, Minquan Zhou, Cong Zhang, Jiaqin Xu, Qisen Yan, Shenzhe Xu, Jiacong Zhu, Zhao Wang, Ke Zhang, Haitao Miao, Jixia Li, Yougang Wang, Tianlu Chen \correspondingAuthor, Xuelei Chen \correspondingAuthor
arxiv-2408-09502.description: Abstract Detecting primordial fluctuations from the cosmic dark ages requires extremely large low-frequency radio telescope arrays deployed on the far side of the Moon. The antenna of such an array must be lightweight, easily storable and transportable, deployable on a large scale, durable, and capable of good electrical performance. A membrane antenna is an excellent candidate to meet these criteria.

arxiv-2410-07121.title: Transfer Learning for E-commerce Query Product Type Prediction
arxiv-2410-07121.creator: Anna Tigunova, Thomas Ricatte, Ghadir Eraisha
arxiv-2410-07121.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Anna Tigunova, Thomas Ricatte, Ghadir Eraisha. Getting a good understanding of the customer intent is essential in e-commerce search engines. In particular, associating the correct product type to a search query plays a vital role in surfacing correct products to the customers. Query product type classification (Q2PT) is a particularly challenging task because search queries are short and ambiguous, the number of existing product categories is extremely large, spanning thousands of values.

pmc-11433072.creator: Catarina Ramos Pereira, Henry J. Greten, Rubim Santos, Ana Mafalda Reis, Bruno Ramos, Maria João Santos, Jorge Machado, Maria Begoña Criado
pmc-11433072.description: Background: Parkinson’s Disease (PD) is a progressive neurodegenerative condition associated with deficit in reaction time which can lead to falls, resulting in limited independence, diminished quality of life, heightened rates of institutionalization and increased healthcare costs. We aimed to examine the effects of an acupuncture protocol in motor time response after an auditory stimulus.

pmc-11476592.creator: Domenico Galzerano, Maria Teresa Savo, Biagio Castaldi, Naji Kholaif, Feras Khaliel, Alice Pozza, Saif Aljheish, Irene Cattapan, Marika Martini, Eleonora Lassandro, Gabriele Cordoni, Donatella Tansella, Dan Alexandru Cozac, Bandar Alamro, Giovanni Di Salvo, Teruhiko Imamura
pmc-11476592.description: Heart failure (HF) remains a critical global health challenge, necessitating advancements in diagnostic and therapeutic strategies. This review explores the evolution of imaging technologies and their impact on HF management, focusing on three-dimensional echocardiography (3DE), myocardial strain imaging, and vortex dynamics imaging.

pmc-11501445.title: Exploring Factors Influencing the Physical and Mental Quality of Life of Caregivers of Cancer Patients: A Cross-Sectional Study at Hassan II University Hospital Center
pmc-11501445.creator: Hiba Bourissi, Hind Bourkhime, Karima El Rhazi, Soufiane Mellas
pmc-11501445.description: BackgroundCancer is a serious public health problem worldwide, causing an impact not only on the patient's quality of life (QoL) but also on their caregiver. This study aims to assess the socio-demographic characteristics, physical and mental QoL, and associated factors among caregivers of cancer patients at the Hassan II University Hospital Center in Fez, Morocco.

pmc-12611042.creator: Leilei Zhang, Gabriele Bellotti, Hajar Salehi, Edoardo Puglisi, Luigi Lucini
pmc-12611042.description: Heavy metal (HM) contamination in agricultural soils poses a significant threat to soil health and plant productivity. pmc-12736608.title: Advances in Drug and Vaccine Delivery for Low- and Middle-Income Healthcare Programs—The Case for Replacing Multi-Dose Vials with Prefilled Single-Dose Delivery Systems
pmc-12736608.creator: Darin Zehrung, Michael J Free, Darko Modun
pmc-12736608.description: The transition toward wide-scale use of single-dose administration systems such as prefilled syringes has primarily occurred in high-income countries due to economic considerations. This has resulted in a disparity of access to such technologies in low- and middle-income countries, which continue to utilize multi-dose vial-based presentations and syringes for parenteral delivery.
